title: 법무장교의 선발에 관한 규칙 / queue:ARTICLE:4:0:00004:part:1/1
full_text:
Article 4 (Selection Screening)
(1) Screening for the selection of legal officers shall be conducted through physical examinations, document screening, and academic-performance screening.
(2) The standards for determining the results of physical examinations shall be those prescribed by the Rules on Physical Examinations for Medical, Legal, Chaplain, and Veterinary Officers, etc.
(3) Document screening shall examine whether the qualifications and experience, etc. of a person eligible for selection as a legal officer are suitable for the performance of the duties of a legal officer. [Amended on October 1, 2025.]
(4) Academic-performance screening shall be based on the candidate's average grade at the Judicial Research and Training Institute or average grade at a law school.
